thread:
alex: Quick sanity check requested — I'm about to promote a small prod overlay change that adds a serviceAccount binding and a RoleBinding for metrics-scraper. Plan looks fine locally but want to catch any gating rules I missed before promote. 

Here's the k8s snippet I added to overlays/prod/namespaces/monitoring.yaml:
```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: monitoring
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: metrics-scraper
  namespace: monitoring
---
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: metrics-scraper-binding
  namespace: monitoring
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: metrics-scraper
  namespace: monitoring
roleRef:
  kind: Role
  name: monitoring-read
  apiGroup: rbac.authorization.k8s.io
```

Also updated terraform to grant the GCP IAM binding to the SA key in private.tf: 
```
resource "google_service_account_iam_binding" "monitoring_scraper" {
  service_account_id = var.monitoring_sa_email
  role               = "roles/monitoring.viewer"
  members            = ["serviceAccount:${var.project_number}@cloudservices.gserviceaccount.com"]
}
```

Can someone check for any prod gating we need (KMS key access, secret paths, or console managed SA exceptions)? @maria @ron @nina

maria: :eyes: quick look — main things to confirm: 1) SA email variable resolves for prod project, 2) KMS encryption policy for the SA if secrets are stored encrypted by customer-managed key, 3) overlay doesn't accidentally modify clusterrole in a global overlay. From the snippet looks scoped to monitoring namespace so good.

ron: Two quick checks from SRE side: 1) Will metrics-scraper need access to Stackdriver write? You're giving viewer only — if it scrapes and pushes to Cloud Monitoring API it might need writer role. 2) If this SA is referenced by external infra (e.g., a Cloud Run job), ensure the serviceAccount annotations are kept in the overlay and not overwritten by kustomize patches in staging.

alex: Good catch on the writer role — it should only read from cluster and export; double-checking app code. For annotations — I added this in the overlay base so staging overlays won't touch it.

nina: A couple of gating/process notes: - For prod overlay promotes we require a terraform plan upload to the release ticket and the plan must include the exact "google_service_account_iam_binding" delta. Please attach plan output (redact project ids if needed). - If the SA key touches KMS, ensure key access policy includes the CI deploy principal otherwise promote will fail during apply.

alex: Uploading plan now. CI: @deploy-bot can you run workspace plan for me?

deploy-bot: CI job started — terraform plan (prod) — workspace: infra/prod — plan id: tp-2389. Link: https://ci.internal/redwood/infra/prod/plans/tp-2389 :spinner:

maria: Also check secrets path: our secretsmanager path convention is projects/<project>/secrets/monitoring/scraper-sa-key — make sure the overlay references that exact path, otherwise secrets-sync will create a duplicate.

alex: Plan posted to ticket (tp-2389). No KMS changes. IAM delta shows binding added to monitoring_sa. Secrets path unchanged.

ron: :white_check_mark: From SRE — no blocking infra concerns. Recommend canary promote to prod with a short monitoring window.

nina: One more admin: please add an entry in the release notes template under "infra changes" stating the SA name and the intended rollout window. Ops will schedule the canary.

alex: Will do. Thanks all — starting the promote canary now and will ping when it's clear. :rocket:
